task.claim:
For each of the archived degree-five quotient moduli over ZMod 11, ZMod 13
and ZMod 19, the actual q-power endomorphism has the frozen C5 factor-kernel
sum equal to its five-term trace kernel of dimension four, is of fifth
power one, and has a one-dimensional fixed kernel disjoint from trace.
